title: Snake Bite — सांप का काटना
warning: Call 108 immediately. Most snake bites are medical emergencies.

steps.instruction: Move the person away from the snake. Do NOT try to catch or kill the snake.
steps.hint: Note the snake's color/pattern if safe — helps doctors identify antivenom

steps.instruction: Keep the person calm and still. Movement speeds up venom spreading through the body.
steps.hint: Reassure them — panic increases heart rate and venom spread

steps.instruction: Remove tight clothing, watches, rings, or anything near the bite site.
steps.hint: Swelling can occur quickly — tight items can cut off circulation

steps.instruction: Keep the bitten limb BELOW heart level. If arm, keep it down. If leg, keep person lying flat.
steps.hint: This slows venom movement toward the heart

steps.instruction: DO NOT: cut the wound, suck out venom, apply tourniquet, apply ice, or give alcohol.
steps.hint: These methods are dangerous and make things worse

steps.instruction: Cover the bite loosely with a clean bandage if available. Do not wrap tightly.
Rush to the nearest hospital immediately. Call 108 for ambulance.
steps.hint: Antivenom is only available at hospitals — time is critical
